blank_step_name.detail_fail: Every step must have a nonblank name
blank_step_name.suggestion: Set a unique nonblank name for each workflow step

duplicate_step.suggestion: Rename duplicate steps and update their incoming edges

empty_subtasks.detail_fail: Steps must contain at least one task
empty_subtasks.suggestion: Add one or more tasks to every step

next_targets.detail_pass: Outgoing edges reference valid unique steps
next_targets.detail_fail: One or more outgoing edges are invalid
next_targets.suggestion: Point every next condition at an existing, unique step

cycle.suggestion: Break the dependency cycle by changing one edge

reachability.suggestion: Connect unreachable or isolated steps, or remove them if they are unused

context_sources.evidence_wildcard: {step}: '*' cannot be combined with named sources
context_sources.evidence_not_ancestor: {step}: context source '{source}' is not an ancestor
context_sources.suggestion: Use existing upstream step names in context_from, or '*' as the only source

duplicate_card.suggestion: Remove duplicate cards or disambiguate provider organization

missing.detail_pass: All remote task agents resolve to an AgentCard
missing.detail_fail: One or more tasks reference unknown agents
missing.suggestion: Check task.agent spelling or register the referenced AgentCard

skill_match.detail_pass: Task skills match their AgentCard declarations
skill_match.detail_fail: Some task skills do not match an AgentCard skill declaration
skill_match.suggestion: Use a matching skill id/name or update the AgentCard skills

task_t_extension.detail_pass: All remote task agents declare Task-T
task_t_extension.detail_fail: Remote tasks reference agents without Task-T capability
task_t_extension.suggestion: Declare Task-T in the AgentCard capabilities.extensions

negotiation_t_extension.detail_pass: Negotiation requirements are covered by AgentCard declarations
negotiation_t_extension.detail_fail: Tasks that appear to require negotiation reference agents without Negotiation-T
negotiation_t_extension.suggestion: Declare Negotiation-T in the AgentCard or remove negotiation requirements

report.risk_intentional_error: An intentional Stub error scenario was selected; report failures are expected.
report.suggestion_inspect_error: Inspect the first workflow error event and the affected downstream steps.
report.suggestion_success_scope: Sandbox success validates structure and scheduling, not real Agent business output.
report.risk_static_failed: Static validation failed; Stub execution was not started.
report.suggestion_fix_static: Fix all static validation failures before sandbox execution.
report.suggestion_runner_exception: Fix the sandbox runner exception and retry verification.
report.risk_service_failed: Sandbox verification failed before a report could be generated.
report.suggestion_check_log: Inspect the backend log and retry verification.

stub.negotiation_proposal: Please provide missing sandbox negotiation information.

sandbox_control_point.self_task_result: Sandbox SelfLoop step {step_name} completed simulated processing.
